patient_facts.finding: Twelve-week history of amenorrhea; vaginal spotting increasing since yesterday. No explicit date or identification of prior spontaneous menstrual period.

source_review.authority: Kirsten Hald, principal investigator, doctoral thesis
source_review.finding: Presents menopause as an exclusion and premenopausal women as recruitment population. Separately excludes recent specified hormonal medication use. Supplies no numeric menopause cutoff.

source_review.authority: Hald et al. 2007 randomized trial, PMID 17197583
source_review.finding: Participants attended gynecology consultation and completed bleeding assessment during last menstrual period before treatment. This was a before-treatment outcome measure; no twelve-month or other menopausal-status decision threshold is given.

source_review.excluded: Numerical cutoff belongs to another trial.

why: No study-specific necessary-and-sufficient duration rule. The onset of a symptom and spotting cannot establish past ovarian function or an accepted true last menstrual period for every relevant etiology. No pregnancy status inferred.
